events.text: Battle of Lepanto: the Holy League defeats the Ottoman fleet.
Ford starts its first moving assembly line for the Model T.
KLM, the oldest airline still operating under its original name, is founded.
The German Democratic Republic (East Germany) is founded.
The barcode is patented by Norman Woodland and Bernard Silver.
The Soviet probe Luna 3 takes the first photographs of the far side of the Moon.
The musical Cats opens on Broadway.
The United States begins its invasion of Afghanistan.
